StartupHakk | AI Engineer Apprentice | Remote (UT or ID residents only) | Full-time | $7.25–$10/hr | startuphakk.com/jobs

We are hiring military veterans (and transitioning service members) living in Utah or Idaho for a paid, 1-year registered remote apprenticeship program in full-stack web development and applied AI.

What You'll Do & Learn:

Full-stack development: C# .NET, React.js, SQL, HTML/CSS, cloud platforms, and DevOps.

Applied AI Engineering: Prompt engineering, LLM integration, running open-source models locally, and building AI features into web applications.

2,000 hours on-the-job learning + 144 hours structured instruction.

Requirements:

U.S. Military Veteran or transitioning service member residing in UT or ID.

18+ years old, HS diploma/GED, eligible to work in the U.S.

Strong passion for tech and continuous learning.

Progressive wage: $7.25/hr (first 1,000 hrs) -> $10.00/hr (second 1,000 hrs).

Apply: Learn more and apply at https://startuphakk.com/jobs
